text: The sponsor brand GCS is Griffin Core Solutions, a Spanish company dedicated to engineering, services and regulation projects in the aerospace sector, founded in 2021 and based in the Vallecas neighbourhood of Madrid; its website legal notice names GRIFFIN CORE SOLUTIONS S.L. as the controller of the site.
short: GCS is Griffin Core Solutions S.L., a Madrid aerospace company founded in 2021.
